headline: Gemini starts rolling out to Android Auto globally
summary: Gemini will replace Google Assistant in Android Auto, the smartphone projection technology integrated into millions of cars, trucks, and SUVs . Google announced the move Thursday that Gemini will start to roll out to Android Auto users who upgraded from Google Assistant to Gemini on their phone . With Gemini, users can ask questions about businesses along their route to find something specific . Users can also reply to messages with Gemini and get summaries of texts .
_source_title: Gemini starts rolling out to Android Auto globally

headline: The best guide to spotting AI writing comes from Wikipedia
summary: Wikipedia has published a guide to “Signs of AI writing” since 2023 . The guide focuses on habits and turns of phrase that are rare on Wikipedia but common on the internet at large . The habits flagged here are deeply embedded in the way AI models are trained and deployed .
_source_title: The best guide to spotting AI writing comes from Wikipedia

headline: After SEC investigation, Curastory founder resigns, hires replacement
summary: SEC accused content monetization startup Curastory of overstating revenue to investors and misrepresenting true client numbers . As a result of a settlement with the SEC, CEO Tiffany Kelly has resigned from the role and replaced herself with Dave Dickman, former CEO of influencer marketing platform Tagger . The settlement agreement specifically barred Kelly for ten years from serving on the board of directors or as an executive at any company that would, essentially, fundraise .
_source_title: After SEC investigation, Curastory founder resigns, hires replacement

headline: Spotify’s latest feature lets you transfer playlists from other services
summary: Spotify is adding an integration with TuneMyMusic, a tool that can transfer playlists from other streaming services . The new feature is rolling out to all Spotify users . It's likely a win for both companies, as it could bring more customers to Spotify . Apple Music already offers a way for users to transfer their saved music from other services .
_source_title: Spotify’s latest feature lets you transfer playlists from other services

headline: India’s TCS gets TPG to fund half of $2B AI data center project
summary: Indian IT giant Tata Consultancy Services has secured $1 billion from private equity firm TPG as part of a multi-year, $2 billion project to build a network of gigawatt-scale data centers in the country . The demand-supply gap for AI compute in India is particularly stark: The country generates nearly 20% of the world’s data, but accounts for only about 3% of global data center capacity .
_source_title: India’s TCS gets TPG to fund half of $2B AI data center project

headline: Another fire breaks out at aluminum plant that supplies Ford
summary: Four-alarm fire breaks out at Novelis aluminum plant in Oswego, New York . Plant supplies sheet metal for Ford's all-electric F-150 Lightning . Plant suffered a major fire in September that stopped operations .
_source_title: Another fire breaks out at aluminum plant that supplies Ford

headline: Google releases Nano Banana Pro, its latest image generation model
summary: Google is upgrading its image generation model with new editing chops, higher resolutions, more accurate text rendering, and the ability to search the web . Dubbed Nano Banana Pro, the new model is built on Google’s latest large language model, Gemini 3, released earlier this week . The model is geared towards giving professionals more control over images, and lets users control aspects like camera angles, scene lighting, depth of field, focus, and color grading .
_source_title: Google releases Nano Banana Pro, its latest image generation model

headline: As its voice dictation app takes off, Wispr secures $25M from Notable Capital
summary: Wispr's dictation app, Wispr Flow, is seeing great traction and has signed 125 enterprise customers . After three months of usage, an average user writes more than 50% of their characters through the app . The company has raised $25 million led by Notable Capital with participation from Steven Bartlett’s Flight Fund . Wispr wants to invest in building its own voice models to understand users better with personalized Automatic Speech Recognition .
_source_title: As its voice dictation app takes off, Wispr secures $25M from Notable Capital

headline: Waymo enters 3 more cities: Minneapolis, New Orleans and Tampa
summary: Waymo will start manually driving its robotaxis in Minneapolis, New Orleans, and Tampa . The company plans to launch a commercial robotaxi service in each of the three new cities in the coming days . The Alphabet-owned company is already offering rides on surface streets and highways in Los Angeles, San Francisco and Phoenix .
_source_title: Waymo enters 3 more cities: Minneapolis, New Orleans and Tampa

headline: Samsung Display, China’s BOE settle OLED patent and trade secret lawsuits
summary: Samsung Display and China's BOE Technology have agreed to settle a patent lawsuit concerning OLED technology . The two companies have agreed that fair technological competition is essential for the advancement of the display industry . The settlement lays to bed a drawn out, three-year fight between Samsung’s display division and BOE, both of whom supply display panels used in Apple devices .
_source_title: Samsung Display, China’s BOE settle OLED patent and trade secret lawsuits

headline: Sortera is turning America’s scrap aluminum problem into cash
summary: Sortera says it has developed a system that can separate aluminum grades with over 95% accuracy . The company uses an AI model that identifies different grades of aluminum based on data from lasers, X-ray fluorescence, and high-speed cameras . The system has to classify each chip — about the size of a large potato chip — in a fraction of a second .
_source_title: Sortera is turning America’s scrap aluminum problem into cash

headline: Finland’s NestAI lands €100M, partners with Nokia to build AI for defense applications
summary: Finnish startup NestAI has raised €100 million (about $115 million) in a funding round led by Finland’s sovereign fund, Tesi, and Nokia . NestAI will build AI products for use in unmanned vehicles, autonomous operations, and command and control platforms . The funding will help NestAI build “Europe's leading physical AI lab,” co-founder Peter Sarlin said at Slush 2025 .
_source_title: Finland’s NestAI lands €100M, partners with Nokia to build AI for defense applications

headline: Uber Eats will use Starship sidewalk robots to deliver food in the UK
summary: Uber Eats is partnering with sidewalk delivery robot company Starship Technologies to deliver food in the U.K. The companies will start the service in the Leeds and Sheffield areas “from select merchants” in December . Starship claims to have nearly 3,000 of its six-wheeled delivery robots in operation around the world .
_source_title: Uber Eats will use Starship sidewalk robots to deliver food in the UK

headline: Monarch Tractor preps for layoffs and warns employees it may ‘shut down’
summary: Autonomous electric tractor startup Monarch Tractor warned staff Thursday it may need to lay off more than 100 employees, or possibly even ‘shut down’ The memo comes after the startup was already cutting some positions over the last few weeks at its California corporate facilities and remote teams in India and Singapore . The company raised at least $220 million, including $133 million in 2024, as it pursued a goal of making “driver optional” autonomous tractors that could perform tasks at places like wineries .
_source_title: Monarch Tractor preps for layoffs and warns employees it may ‘shut down’

headline: Nvidia’s record $57B revenue and upbeat forecast quiets AI bubble talk
summary: Nvidia reported revenue of $57 billion in the third quarter, 62% higher compared to the same quarter last year . The company’s net income on a GAAP basis was $32 billion, 65% higher year-over-year . The revenue picture shows a company booming thanks largely to its data center business . The remaining $5.8 billion in revenue came from the gaming business with $4.2 billion .
_source_title: Nvidia’s record $57B revenue and upbeat forecast quiets AI bubble talk

headline: How the classic anime ‘Ghost in the Shell’ predicted the future of cybersecurity 30 years ago
summary: The story of the Puppet Master was ahead of its time may be an understatement . The World Wide Web, essentially what flourished from the internet as we know it today, was invented in 1989, the same year that the first volume of “Ghost in the Shell’s” manga hit newsstands in Japan .
_source_title: How the classic anime ‘Ghost in the Shell’ predicted the future of cybersecurity 30 years ago

headline: Cavela lands $6.6M to help brands beat pre-tariff manufacturing costs
summary: Cavela raises $6.6 million in seed funding from XYZ Venture Capital and Susa Ventures . The startup helps brands find potential suppliers in over 40 countries and negotiate product specifications and pricing . It estimates that its customers save an average of 35% on production costs .
_source_title: Cavela lands $6.6M to help brands beat pre-tariff manufacturing costs

headline: VC Jennifer Neundorfer explains how founders can stand out in a crowded AI market
summary: January Ventures co-founder Jennifer Neundorfer stopped by the Equity podcast during TechCrunch Disrupt to chat about fundraising in this very AI-driven market . She says a market correction is probably coming, and a lot of the companies getting windfalls of investor money now might not survive . The winners will navigate this moment building “truly category-defining companies”
_source_title: VC Jennifer Neundorfer explains how founders can stand out in a crowded AI market

headline: Function Health raises $298M Series B at $2.5B valuation
summary: Function Health recently raised $298 million in a Series B round led by Redpoint Ventures at a valuation of $2.5 billion . The company recently unveiled Medical Intelligence Lab, an effort to build a “medical intelligence” generative AI model that can be used to provide personalized health insights based on users’ data, content, and research . Function Health offers a regular lab testing service to help people track their health .
_source_title: Function Health raises $298M Series B at $2.5B valuation

headline: Spotify acquires music database WhoSampled
summary: Spotify has acquired WhoSampled, a community-run database tracking sampled music . The London-based site offers an extensive database of songs, samples, covers, remixes, artists, and more . It's now tracking more than 1.2 million songs and nearly 622,000 samples . Deal terms were not disclosed .
_source_title: Spotify acquires music database WhoSampled
